concept.title: Mental health and wellbeing support
concept.shortdesc: Support, therapies, courses and programmes for mental health, addiction recovery and general health and wellbeing.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Time-limited recovery or supportive programmes and workshops, often several weeks long, that help people recover and prevent relapse.
: Group sessions, workshops and activity programmes aimed generally at improving health and wellbeing.
: Support, advice, groups and harm reduction services for people who want to cut down, stop or stay safe around drugs, alcohol, gambling or other addictions.
: Support to make healthy lifestyle changes and improve overall physical and mental wellbeing, including help with eating and smoking.
: Support, care, information and crisis help for people with mental health difficulties or wanting to look after their mental wellbeing.
: Courses, workshops and training that teach people to understand and manage mental health, stress, anxiety and low mood.
: Receiving structured psychological treatments such as CBT, EMDR, psychotherapy and talking therapies.
